title: 第一卷 第1章 这样死去怎能甘心第一卷 第2章
content_zh:
“林辰，你通敌叛国，意欲颠覆大魏国祚，自立为王，你可知罪！”
一声大喝响彻整个宫殿。
玄天大陆，大魏国，高邈庙堂之上。
大魏国元帅赵无极，浑身上下铁血杀气弥漫，冷冷的逼视阶下那浑身是血的少年。
少年名叫林辰，大魏国将门林氏少帅，乃是帝国年轻一辈第一天才！
年纪轻轻，便已经修炼到了第四境凝意境，破了整个大魏国有史以来最年轻凝意武者的纪录！
甚至连位于世外的青玄神门都对林辰伸出橄榄枝，有意收他为徒！
而大魏皇帝为了封赏林辰，更是将最为宠爱的小公主许配给他。
风头之盛，一时无两！
只是谁能想到，就在前不久还是帝国红极一时的少年将军，接替其父率领林家军，于边境所向披靡的林氏少帅！
今日，却被囚于阶下，浑身经脉尽数被挑断，修为全废！
殿内寂静，所有人都是不敢开口。
因为他们知道，这为帝国开疆拓土，奠定如今大魏二分之一国祚的林氏将门，今日，将彻底覆灭！
“通敌叛国？”
林辰吐出几口血沫，他盯着赵无极愤怒嘶吼，“我林氏为大魏，战死了多少儿郎！
我五弟战死的时候才十四岁，十四岁！
但我林氏，依旧前仆后继，虽死不悔！”
“现在，你们告诉我，告诉天下人，我林氏要反，要勾结血海深仇的上吴国，要颠覆大魏国祚！”
“可笑！”
林辰的嘶吼在大殿之中回荡，许多人都是变了神色。

赵帅脸色难看，他看了一眼端坐九五至尊宝座的皇帝，后者淡漠的看着这一切，好像完全没有听到林辰那血泪的嘶吼一般。
如此，赵帅轻描淡写的开口：“林氏有功，的确不假，但那不过是臣子本分，这不是你们犯上作乱的理由！”
“如今陛下念在你林氏有功，没有将你林氏一门满门抄斩，已经是网开一面，你还有什么不知足的？”
林辰含着血沫，紧咬着牙，“我林氏世代忠良，有罪的，是你，是你们！”
“冥顽不灵！”
赵帅声音冰冷，“来人，将那些参与谋反的叛逆给本帅押上来！”
林辰闻言，眼中第一次有了慌乱。
他转身看去，是一个个熟悉的身影，他们都穿着囚服，浑身是血，是与他一同浴血奋战的袍泽，是为国家抛洒热血的战士！
“放过他们！
他们都是忠良之士，他们不该死在这里！”
林辰嘶吼。
“乱臣贼子，何来忠良，杀！”
赵帅大喝一声。
一个个将士，袍泽，生死的兄弟。
随着一道道血肉分离的声音，头颅落地。
“啊！
！”
林辰含泪嘶吼，谁都能够听出他心中的悲恸。
很快，阶下就又有锁铐碰撞的声音响起，另一批人被押了上来，竟皆是老弱病残！
在场帝国贵胄，此刻都是一阵阵心寒，已经不忍再看。

这些，都是林氏族人，是在战场流干了血泪的战士！
“这些参与谋反的林氏逆党，也要杀！”
赵无极神色淡漠的喝道，依旧冷酷无情。
content_en:
"Lin Chen, you collaborated with the enemy and treason, intending to overthrow Zuo of Wei and establish yourself as king. Do you know your crime?"
A loud shout echoed throughout the palace.
Xuantian Continent, the Great Wei State, above the Gaomiao Temple.
The Marshal of the Wei State, Zhao Wuji, was filled with iron-blooded murderous aura, and he looked coldly at the blood-covered young man below the steps.
The young man's name is Lin Chen, Marshal Lin of the Wei Kingdom's generals, and he is the number one genius among the younger generation of the empire!
At such a young age, he has already cultivated to the fourth level of condensing the mind, breaking the record of being the youngest condensing warrior in the history of the entire Wei Kingdom!
Even the Qingxuan Divine Sect located outside the world extended an olive branch to Lin Chen and intended to accept him as a disciple!
In order to reward Lin Chen, the Emperor of Wei even betrothed his favorite little princess to him.
The popularity is unprecedented!
But who would have thought that not long ago, the young general who was a smash hit in the empire would succeed his father in leading the Lin family army and become the invincible young marshal of the Lin family on the border!
Today, he was imprisoned under the stairs, all the meridians in his body were severed, and his cultivation was completely ruined!
The hall was silent, and no one dared to speak.
Because they knew that the Lin family general who opened up the empire and established one-half of the current Wei Dynasty, Zuo, would be completely destroyed today!
"Collaboration with the enemy and treason?"
Lin Chen spat out a few mouthfuls of blood, stared at Zhao Wuji and roared angrily, "I, Lin, belong to the Wei Dynasty, and how many men have been killed in battle!
My fifth brother was only fourteen years old when he died in the battle, fourteen years old!
But I, the Lin family, will continue to work hard, and I will never regret it even if I die! "
"Now, tell me, tell everyone in the world, I, the Lin family, want to rebel, collude with the bloody feuding Shang Wu State, and overthrow the great Wei State Zuo!"
"Ridiculous!"
Lin Chen's roar echoed in the hall, and many people's expressions changed.
Zhao Shuai's face was ugly. He glanced at the emperor who was sitting on the Ninth Five Supreme Throne. The latter looked at everything indifferently, as if he didn't hear Lin Chen's roar of blood and tears at all.
In this way, Zhao Shuai said lightly: "It is true that Lin has meritorious service, but that is just the duty of a minister. This is not the reason for you to commit rebellion!"
"Now that Your Majesty is counting on your Lin family's merits, he has not killed all of your Lin family members. He has already opened up the net. What else are you dissatisfied with?"
Lin Chen held blood in his mouth and gritted his teeth, "I, the Lin family, have been loyal and loyal for generations, and it is you who are guilty!"
"Stubborn!"
Zhao Shuai's voice was cold, "Come here, bring those rebels who participated in the rebellion to me!"
Hearing this, Lin Chen felt panic in his eyes for the first time.
He turned around and saw familiar figures. They were all wearing prison uniforms and covered in blood. They were the soldiers who fought bloody battles with him, and they were soldiers who shed blood for the country!
"Let them go!
They are all loyal men and they should not die here! "
Lin Chen roared.
"Those rebellious ministers and traitors are so loyal and good, kill them!"
Zhao Shuai shouted loudly.
Each and every soldier is a brother in life and death.
With the sounds of flesh and blood being separated, the head fell to the ground.
"Ah!
! "
Lin Chen roared with tears in his eyes, and everyone could hear the grief in his heart.
Soon, the sound of cuffs and cuffs was heard again at the foot of the stairs, and another group of people were escorted up. They were all old, weak, sick and disabled!
The imperial nobles present were all filled with chills at this moment and could no longer bear to watch.
These are all members of the Lin clan, warriors who have shed their blood and tears on the battlefield!
"These Lin rebels who participated in the rebellion must also be killed!"
Zhao Wuji shouted indifferently, still ruthless.
